newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Telekom Malaysia lowers foreign call rate.
newsitem.headline: Telekom Malaysia lowers foreign call rate.

text.p: Telekom Malaysia Bhd said in a statement on Monday it had reduced the cost of international calls to 35 countries to boost Malaysia's competitiveness as a business centre.

The new call rates, cheaper by three to 18 percent, were made possible by the upgrading of Telekom's infrastructure network and fiscal management practices, which helped reduce costs, Telekom Chief Executive Mohamed Said Mohamed Ali said.
He said the new rates will enable callers to "enjoy significant reductions in their phone bills".
The new rates apply to most of Europe, the United States, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong and several Asian countries, said Telekom.
"It is hoped that this will improve Malaysia's competitiveness and cost-effectiveness as a business centre," he added.
Telekom's share price was unchanged at 17.00 ringgit as at Monday's close.
